Record Class LessonGateway.Lesson

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
guiLessonSupport.LessonGateway.Lesson
Enclosing interface:
LessonGateway
public static record LessonGateway.Lesson(long id, String author, String title, String category, String situation, String lessonText, boolean lessonLocked, boolean titleLocked, boolean categoryLocked, boolean situationLocked, boolean lessonTextLocked, boolean curatorEdited, LocalDateTime createdAt, LocalDateTime updatedAt) extends Record
Contributor-visible state. Current base has no locks, curator flag or timestamps; those values are available only through a connected TP2 extension. Null timestamps mean unknown.
